words.meaning: A confusing mystery, riddle, or puzzle.
words.example: The riddle remained an enigma.

words.meaning: Give up, surrender, or renounce a throne or high office.
words.example: The king relinquished his crown.

words.meaning: Short-lived, momentary, and passing quickly.
words.example: The rainbow was transient.

words.hindi: पूरी तरह नष्ट करना / मिटा देना
words.meaning: Destroy completely or wipe out.
words.example: The bulldozer obliterated the illegal structure.

words.meaning: Compulsory, essential, and absolutely required.
words.example: Wearing a mask was obligatory during COVID-19.

words.meaning: Beginning to happen or develop; in an initial stage.
words.example: The project is still in its incipient stage.

words.meaning: Superficial, careless, and done with minimal effort.
words.example: The maid did a perfunctory cleaning of the room.

words.meaning: Of doubtful authenticity; spurious and fictitious.
words.example: The story is considered apocryphal.

words.meaning: Filled with bitter criticism or malice.
words.example: He launched a vitriolic attack on his critics.

words.meaning: Loud, booming, and resonant in sound.
words.example: The commander spoke in a stentorian voice.

words.meaning: Showing or feeling no interest; unconcerned and impassive.
words.example: Many voters remained apathetic during the local election.

words.meaning: Having or showing great energy; ardent and fervid.
words.example: Zealous students revise their notes daily.

words.meaning: Requiring or using great effort or exertion; laborious.
words.example: The arduous training tested their strength.

words.hindi: अति सावधान / बारीकी से काम करने वाला
words.meaning: Showing great attention to detail; scrupulous and punctilious.
words.example: She is meticulous about keeping her study table organized.

words.meaning: An unorthodox individualist or nonconformist.
words.example: As a maverick thinker, he proposed a unique solution.

words.hindi: गैर-ज़रूरी / जिसके बिना काम चल सके
words.meaning: Able to be replaced or done without; superfluous.
words.example: Luxury items are dispensable during a financial crisis.

words.hindi: पेटू / बहुत अधिक खाने या पढ़ने वाला
words.meaning: Wanting or devouring great quantities of food; insatiable.
words.example: He is a voracious reader of history books.

words.meaning: Open to more than one interpretation; vague and uncertain.
words.example: The road sign was equivocal and confused drivers.

words.meaning: Gentle, kindly, and harmless in effect.
words.example: The doctor confirmed that the tumor was benign.

words.meaning: Irritable, peevish, and quarrelsome.
words.example: The tired child became fractious during the long journey.

words.meaning: Hostile, adverse, and tending to harm.
words.example: Lack of sleep is inimical to good exam performance.

words.meaning: Not having any serious purpose or value; petty and flippant.
words.example: Do not waste time on frivolous arguments.

words.meaning: Prevent or hinder the progress of something.
words.example: Lack of funds stymied the research project.

words.meaning: Of such excellence, grandeur, or beauty as to inspire great admiration.
words.example: The view from the mountain peak was truly sublime.

words.meaning: Delicately small and pretty; exquisite.
words.example: She wore a dainty gold chain around her neck.
